fields.name: id
fields.doc: Unique ID of the merchant accepting the transaction

fields.name: subId
fields.doc: Sub-merchant ID, used when there are multiple merchants under a single account

fields.name: terminalId
fields.doc: ID of the terminal where the transaction was made

fields.name: merchantCategoryCode
fields.doc: Merchant category code indicating the type of merchant (e.g., retail, restaurant)

fields.name: merchantName
fields.doc: The name of the merchant

fields.name: merchantCity
fields.doc: The city where the merchant is located

fields.name: merchantCountry
fields.doc: The country where the merchant is located

fields.name: acquiringInstitutionId
fields.doc: Bank ID of acquirer

fields.name: acquirerBin
fields.doc: Bank Identification Number

fields.name: acquirerCountry
fields.doc: Acquirer Country

fields.name: issuerBIN
fields.doc: Issuer Bank Identification Number for detecting card type, region, and rules

fields.name: idChargeback
fields.doc: Chargeback transaction id

fields.name: originalId
fields.doc: Original transaction Id

fields.name: representmentReasonCode
fields.doc: The reason for the representation

fields.name: idPreClearing
fields.doc: Unique identifier for the clearing entry

fields.name: settlementAmount
fields.doc: The currency of the settlement amount

fields.name: dccCurrency
fields.doc: The DCC currency used in the transaction

fields.name: dccMarkup
fields.doc: The markup added to the DCC transaction

fields.name: paymentInstrumentId
fields.doc: Unique identifier for the payment instrument

fields.name: maskedPan
fields.doc: The masked (partially obfuscated) PAN of the card used for the transaction

fields.name: sequence
fields.doc: Sequence number to identify the card usage instance (e.g., recurring payments)

fields.name: expiryDate
fields.doc: The expiration date of the card

fields.name: reversalType
fields.doc: Reversal type (Partial/Total)

fields.name: reversalReason
fields.doc: Reason for reversal

fields.name: reversalAmount
fields.doc: Reversed amount

fields.name: settlementNetwork
fields.doc: The payment network used in the settlement (e.g., Visa, Mastercard)

fields.name: transactionType
fields.doc: Transaction type (Purchase, Load, etc.)

fields.name: transactionExternalId
fields.doc: Id sent by the processor

fields.name: transactionCountryCode
fields.doc: Country code of the transaction

fields.name: transactionStatus
fields.doc: Lifecycle of the transaction

fields.name: transactionAmount
fields.doc: Amount based on transaction status

fields.name: transactionCurrency
fields.doc: Currency of amount (ISO4217 or numeric)

fields.name: transactionAdditionalAmount
fields.doc: Additional Amount, Field 54 ISO8583

fields.name: xPayWalletAuthMethod
fields.doc: Authentication method used in the wallet transaction (e.g., biometric, PIN)

fields.name: transactionRequestDatetime
fields.doc: Acceptor local time

fields.name: transactionRequestBillingAmount
fields.doc: Amount billed in issuer currency

fields.name: transactionRequestBillingCurrency
fields.doc: Billing currency (ISO4217)

fields.name: transactionRequestStan
fields.doc: Systems Trace Audit Number

fields.name: transactionRequestRetrievalReferenceNumber
fields.doc: Retrieval Reference Number

fields.name: transactionRequestTransmissionDatetime
fields.doc: UTC transmission datetime

fields.name: transactionRequestBillingRate
fields.doc: Conversion rate

fields.name: transactionRequestScheme
fields.doc: Scheme processed the transaction

fields.name: recurringFlag
fields.doc: Recurring payment?

fields.name: magneticStripe
fields.doc: Indicates if the card was swiped (magnetic stripe entry)

fields.name: emvChip
fields.doc: Indicates if the card was inserted for EMV chip-based processing

fields.name: contactless
fields.doc: Indicates if the card was used for a contactless transaction (NFC)

fields.name: manualEntry
fields.doc: Indicates if the card details were manually entered

fields.name: fallback
fields.doc: Indicates if fallback processing was used (in case of EMV failure)

fields.name: nfc
fields.doc: Indicates if NFC was used for the transaction

fields.name: cardPresent
fields.doc: Indicates whether the card was physically present during the transaction

fields.name: transactionCondition
fields.doc: Condition of the transaction (e.g., standard, refund)

fields.name: pinVerification
fields.doc: Indicates if PIN verification was performed

fields.name: signatureAuthorization
fields.doc: Indicates if signature authorization was used

fields.name: onlineAuthorization
fields.doc: Indicates whether online authorization was performed

fields.name: offlineAuthorization
fields.doc: Indicates whether offline authorization was used

fields.name: channel
fields.doc: Indicates whether the transaction is face-to-face or remote (non-face-to-face)

fields.name: serviceCode
fields.doc: Specifies the card service type (e.g., debit, credit)

fields.name: transactionSequenceCounter
fields.doc: A unique sequence number for the transaction

fields.name: terminalType
fields.doc: Type of terminal used to process the transaction (e.g., POS, ATM)

fields.name: terminalCapabilities
fields.doc: Defines terminal capabilities (e.g., EMV, NFC)

fields.name: iac
fields.doc: Issuer Action Code (indicates transaction outcome)

fields.name: ac
fields.doc: Cryptogram used in authorization (ARQC/TC/AAC)

fields.name: cid
fields.doc: Cryptogram Identifier, indicates the type of cryptogram

fields.name: aip
fields.doc: Application Interchange Profile, defines card capabilities

fields.name: iad
fields.doc: Issuer Application Data, used for issuer-specific risk management

fields.name: authenticationIndicator
fields.doc: Indicates the result of 3D Secure authentication (e.g., successful, failed)

fields.name: threeDSVersion
fields.doc: Specifies the version of 3D Secure used

fields.name: issuerAuthenticationData
fields.doc: Data used by the issuer for authentication

fields.name: authenticationResponse
fields.doc: Response from the issuer regarding authentication outcome

fields.name: cavv
fields.doc: Cardholder Authentication Verification Value (used in 3D Secure)

fields.name: dsTransID
fields.doc: 3D Secure 2 transaction identifier

fields.name: amid
fields.doc: Authentication Method Indicator used in 3D Secure (e.g., biometric, PIN)

fields.name: aav
fields.doc: Mastercard's equivalent of CAVV used in 3D Secure for cardholder authentication

fields.name: eci
fields.doc: Electronic Commerce Indicator used in 3D Secure transactions

fields.name: walletId
fields.doc: Unique identifier for the wallet user in the xPay system

fields.name: deviceId
fields.doc: Identifier for the mobile device used for the transaction

fields.name: code
fields.doc: The approval code from the issuer

fields.name: amount
fields.doc: The amount authorized by the issuer

fields.name: datetime
fields.doc: Response timestamp from the issuer

fields.name: reason
fields.doc: Reason for rejection if the transaction was declined

fields.name: authorizationId
fields.doc: The authorization number returned by the issuer
